name: storyblok-component-schema
description: TypeScript DSL and CLI for managing Storyblok components as code. Includes skills for installation, component creation, and all schema field types.

plugins.name: install
plugins.description: Install and configure @jimdrury/storyblok-component-schema in a project. Registry setup, config file, credentials, and CI integration.

plugins.name: create-component
plugins.description: Create and configure Storyblok component definitions using the TypeScript schema DSL. Component types, field types, tabs, block restrictions, and validation.

plugins.name: content-type
plugins.description: Use the contentType() factory to define root-level Storyblok components like pages, articles, or settings.

plugins.name: nestable
plugins.description: Use the nestable() factory to define reusable Storyblok blocks that can be embedded inside other components via blocks() fields.

plugins.name: text
plugins.description: Use the text() factory for single-line text input fields like titles, headings, or slugs.

plugins.name: textarea
plugins.description: Use the textarea() factory for multi-line plain text fields like descriptions or bios.

plugins.name: richtext
plugins.description: Use the richtext() factory for WYSIWYG rich text editor fields.

plugins.name: markdown
plugins.description: Use the markdown() factory for markdown editor fields.

plugins.name: number
plugins.description: Use the number() factory for numeric input fields like prices, ratings, or quantities.

plugins.name: datetime
plugins.description: Use the datetime() factory for date and time picker fields.

plugins.name: boolean
plugins.description: Use the boolean() factory for toggle/checkbox fields.

plugins.name: option
plugins.description: Use the option() factory for single-select dropdown fields. Supports inline options, datasources, and internal stories.

plugins.name: options
plugins.description: Use the options() factory for multi-select dropdown fields.

plugins.name: blocks
plugins.description: Use the blocks() factory for nested component block fields. Controls which nestable components editors can add, reorder, and remove.

plugins.name: multilink
plugins.description: Use the multilink() factory for link fields supporting internal stories, external URLs, email, and asset links.

plugins.name: asset
plugins.description: Use the asset() factory for single file/image picker fields.

plugins.name: multiasset
plugins.description: Use the multiasset() factory for multiple file/image picker fields like galleries.

plugins.name: tab
plugins.description: Use the tab() factory to group fields into editor tabs. UI-only, does not affect content structure.

plugins.name: table
plugins.description: Use the table() factory for editable spreadsheet-like table fields.

plugins.name: references
plugins.description: Use the references() factory for story reference picker fields. Lets editors pick published stories from the space.
